body.name: mandatory early-kill instance
body.construction: For \(\iota_{\mathrm{kill}}=(3,1/20,[1/100,1/100],2,1/100,1/20)\), an admissible output must keep \(K=2\) and \(h=1/100\), give a deterministic primal policy valid for every \(s\in\mathcal S_3\), and give a complete integrality-preserving lower witness with \(0\le U_\varepsilon-b_\varepsilon\le1/20\). A sampled-share check, a fixed-share certificate, or an unresolved linear-programming relaxation is not an admissible output.
